cohort: 98 pregnant women with GDM and 132 pregnant women with normal glucose tolerance at 24-28 weeks of gestation
finding: Plasma zonulin levels were significantly higher in pregnant women with GDM compared to those with normal glucose tolerance, and a cut-off value of >45.2 ng/mL could predict GDM with high sensitivity and specificity.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in women with GDM compared to controls.
